caption:
The team built a chat tool to make their game. The game shut down. The chat tool became Slack. 💬 Ever had a 'side thing' turn into the main thing? 👇

Source: Wikipedia

#DidYouKnow #Slack #StartupStory #Pivot #Founders

post.news: Did you know? Slack began as the office chat tool for a video game called Glitch. The game failed.
post.take: The game flopped, the office chat won. Your side project might be the real project.
